---
name: Feature request / 功能请求
about: Suggest a small, scoped improvement to the research-only product surface
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

## Problem / 你想解决什么问题

Describe the workflow that is currently blocked, confusing, or too manual.
请描述当前被阻塞、容易误解或过于手工的使用流程。

## Proposed change / 希望的改动

Describe the smallest change that would help.
请尽量说明一个最小、可审查的改动。

## Why this fits LensOS Option / 为什么这符合产品边界

- Keep the request inside `RESEARCH_ONLY / NO_TRADE`.
- Avoid asking for live execution, account automation, or hidden data access.

## Evidence or examples / 证据或例子

Add screenshots, commands, or example outputs when they help.
有帮助的话，请附截图、命令或输出样例。
